paragraphs: R' Yehoshua bar Binyamin bar Levi. Mentioned at the end of Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 4; R' Chuna reported in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: שהש״ר ספ״ד is read as Shir HaShirim Rabbah, end of chapter 4, without independent named-edition verification. Chuna reports in the heading figure’s name; חונה is not silently replaced by הונא.
The two bar relationships preserve three generations. Both abbreviated personal titles remain R'; no family or historical identity is inferred.
